issues.description: The visibility of the Person.firstName field differs between artifacts: the problem statement's UML indicates private fields (and the template Person class declares firstName as private), but the solution's Person class makes firstName public. This inconsistency between template/problem and solution can confuse students about intended encapsulation and expected access patterns (getters/setters) and may mislead them when comparing their implementation to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.firstName field consistently private and use the existing getter/setter across all artifacts (update the solution's Person.java to declare 'private String firstName;') so the template, problem statement UML, and reference implementation align on encapsulation.
